answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a nadir bet on surviving 118 epochs of grading, and every vault settlement recomputes the pearl schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 118 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
